name: Paper Crane

/* Paper Crane: folded cranes hanging against handmade washi paper (original photo-style illustration). The cranes hang in the free strip right of the conversation and bob gently, a little livelier while the agent works; every surface is a crisp folded sheet with square corners, and a coral crease over the composer grows as the context fills. Light only. */
